DTCs.name: Oxygen Sensor (O2) Fault
DTCs.description: Oxygen sensor signal not detected or out of expected range.

DTCs.name: Coolant Temperature Sensor Fault
DTCs.description: Engine coolant temperature reading not detected or out of range.

DTCs.name: Crankshaft Position Sensor Fault

DTCs.name: Camshaft Position Sensor Fault
DTCs.description: Camshaft position signal is out of range or missing.

DTCs.name: Knock Sensor Fault
DTCs.description: Knock sensor signal not detected or out of range.

DTCs.name: Intake Air Temperature (IAT) Sensor Fault
DTCs.description: IAT sensor signal missing or out of range.

DTCs.name: Manifold Absolute Pressure (MAP) Sensor Fault
